verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MX offers separate data products: Instant Account Verification for account and routing numbers, Account Owner Identification for name and address, and Account Aggregation for 90 days of data. Nothing in the pack documents consents scoped to those products, scope selection at connection time, or data-minimization controls. Modular products are an adjacent feature, not the per-scope consent mechanism the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
